title: House Vanilla Ice Cream
description: A rich vanilla ice cream built on a light-cream, whole-milk, and whole-egg base with an intentionally generous dose of vanilla.
totalTime: Overnight chilling plus churning and freezing
ingredients: 100 g whole egg (about 2 large eggs, without shells)
steps: Whisk the eggs until light and slightly foamy, then gradually whisk in the sugar until fully combined.
Whisk in the light cream and whole milk.
Heat the mixture gently, stirring constantly, until it reaches 170°F (77°C). Do not boil.
Remove from the heat and cool slightly, then stir in the vanilla extract.
Cover and chill completely, preferably overnight.
Churn according to your ice cream maker’s instructions.
Transfer to a container and freeze until firm.
notes: Be generous with the 28 g vanilla. This is intentionally a heavy vanilla dose and is the version that produced the standout batch. The base is a modified Ben & Jerry’s-style sweet cream formula using light cream rather than heavy cream.
